verdict.rationale: Appwrite's docs say developers can 'use one of our many SDKs' alongside REST and GraphQL, and the CLI `generate` command builds a type-safe SDK from the project's schema. AI-focused resources (Skills, MCP docs context, 'SDK-accurate calls') are built around those official SDKs, which suits AI-native development. Missing for 10: an enumerated list of supported SDK languages/platforms, SDK reference depth (versioning, maintenance), and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
